claim: Author documents 2021 geography with lookup releases in late 2021/early 2022; this is not proof of the route used for tochno v20260605.
Separate FNS workers enrichment is described for legal entities, not sole traders.
Within taxpayer/data_date the author's window orders document revisions descending; availability as of a historical prediction date is not established.
Worker year comes from data_date, not publication filename or doc_date.
The local route removes original address fields after constructing the mapping; its output alone does not preserve the entire raw address record.
Duplicate lookup keys are excluded for each matching option in the local route; raw duplicate keys are not automatically an erroneous accepted join.
The alternative route takes the first returned DaData suggestion; no DaData requests were made in this audit.
Annual workers join uses tax_number/year; this code does not prove the exact source archive revisions used by tochno.
